adjudication: NUM-WEB-11 accepts the in-scope need for safe recovery actions/guidance but does not accept its unverified assumption of a conclusive readback. Where provider evidence cannot reconcile an ambiguous mutation, retain visible pending/manual state and use the already approved controlled fresh-authorization path; do not invent fields or replay code/PIN/registration/subscription automatically.
adapter_parse: Exact boolean true or documented exact string true can express explicit success. Reject missing, false, false string and other truthy values; 2xx alone is insufficient. Real Graph-version response remains to be observed.
